scope:
Exact axial support gaps of complete finite warm cores, not whole held gaps.

Reads every coefficient from the original complete geometry reports.  The
identity d=2 sum_{j odd} c_{2j} is the axial quarter-phase support difference
used by R40.  No new surface, RHS, Jacobian, tail or BVP is evaluated.
old_LP_objective: maximize first coefficient c2 in a bounded local step, not the exact complete d or its ratio
limitations: The displayed d is the exact finite planar support identity for the saved binary64 coefficients.
No new core is relabeled as a converged prefix or closed surface.
2r is a sample of an origin sphere expression on an open warm prefix, not the full continuous closed diameter D.
No non-occlusion, fixed-H, actual held, Euclidean separation, reach, exact isometry or refinement gate is established.
